label: Radxa ROCK 5B SBC
description: Rockchip RK3588 SBC with a single 2.5GbE port (PoE with an add-on HAT) and an M.2 E-key slot for a Wi-Fi module; the base 5B ships without a radio.
notes: Single 2.5GbE, no onboard Wi-Fi/BT on the plain 5B (the ROCK 5B+ adds an RTL8852BE Wi-Fi 6 module - model that variant separately if needed). Same RK3588 class as the Orange Pi 5 Plus but half the NICs.
